# pidginhost_domain_glue_record (Resource)

A glue record of a domain registered with PidginHost: it registers <name>.<domain> at the registry as a name server host with the given addresses, so domains can delegate to it. The domain service must be active.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_domain_glue_record" "ns1" {
  domain = "example.com"
  name   = "ns1"
  ip     = "192.0.2.53"
  ip2    = "2001:db8::53"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name, such as example.com.
- `ip` (String) IP address of the name server host.
- `name` (String) Label of the name server host, such as ns1 for ns1.example.com. It is compared without case.

### Optional

- `ip2` (String) Second IP address of the name server host.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <domain>/<name>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a glue record by "<domain>/<name>".
terraform import pidginhost_domain_glue_record.ns1 example.com/ns1
```
